resources.string: Even if the app you are using is not here, you can still manually open the app and see if it works with diffuse.

Diffuse, a live wallpaper that blurs your current playing album art and displays it in a fluid-like manner in real-time. With our in-house solution Live Beats™, the background also moves when the beat drops. It is alive, vibrant, and it never gets old.
Long press on each option to see what it does
Audio permissions are necessary for Diffuse to receive current audio output and use it to enable Live Beats. It is OK not to grant this if you do not need beat-sensitive animations.

Diffuse grabs album arts by reading other music app\'s notifications, and thus Diffuse only works with music apps that use stock music notifications, including Apple Music, Spotify, Google Play Music, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, etc. Certain music players, like QQ Music, might require you to manually set the app to use system-style notification to work, as they are using customized (and thus not supported) notification style by default.

Live Beats detects beats in real-time. In order to read audio streams from other music apps, audio permissions are required. Diffuse only record device output, not mics, and the method with which Diffuse handles recording is completely under Google\'s documentation and recommendations, so there is no need to worry.
Why does Live Beats need audio permissions?
